pages.title: Sands Remember
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: First defeat Dune Sentinel, Mummy and Golden Hermit King, then explore the Cursed Pyramid and obtain the Necklace of the Desert for its native awakening. This is world history, not proof of personal participation. Dedicated servers retain hosted encounter admission; singleplayer uses native combat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The encounter owner awards eyes and trophies.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: On dedicated hosts, attacking a dormant boss opens preparation; confirmation starts combat. Party affects difficulty and entry/exit. Singleplayer/LAN keeps native combat without /smp or events.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: World Tier is shared. Thresholds follow the active qualifying boss roster and saved profile; repeated kills do not add a new boss type. Twelve campaign eyes and tier progression roster are different sets.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Brush suspicious sand in the Cursed Pyramid for Necklace of the Desert.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the necklace on a Remnant lacking one; the native operation consumes it and starts awakening.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Desert Eye locates Cursed Pyramid. A native locator does not replace canonical JEM admission. Check its current acquisition recipe.
